entities.name: Thomas Francis Johnson
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Thomas Francis Johnson was a U.S. Congressman who represented Maryland's 1st congressional district from January 3, 1959 to January 3, 1963. He lost his third re-election after criminal charges were brought against him.
